teaser: This issue centers on generative AI's mixed track record across three papers: chatbots and language models can draft investigation reports, support chronic disease education, or code newspaper sentiment, but each study found real limits, from overcoding in qualitative analysis to unresolved safety and literacy gaps. A workforce study raises a different caution, linking heavy AI reliance in nursing students to reduced focus. Meanwhile, one hospital's digital closed-loop workflow improved surgical timing and staff experience at scale, and a Hong Kong pilot protocol aims to test chatbot-assisted advance care planning conversations with families.

themes.name: AI's cognitive and educational impact on students
Digital tools for care coordination and family engagement
